requirement_cases.situation: A selector has no identifiable candidate.
requirement_cases.consequence: Reasoning approach selection cannot successfully complete; Reasoning approach availability can correctly return none.

requirement_cases.situation: A user directly supplies one applicable approach.
requirement_cases.consequence: Selection is possible without a search, comparison ranking, or prior repository lookup.

requirement_cases.situation: A workflow constructs an approach before choosing it.
requirement_cases.consequence: Creation precedes this choice in this case; candidates need not preexist the whole workflow.

requirement_cases.situation: A usable approach is accessible but the agent fails to recognize it as a candidate.
requirement_cases.consequence: Availability, identification and actual use remain different determinations.

requirement_cases.situation: The selector can inspect an approach whose input assumptions fail in the live case.
requirement_cases.consequence: Availability does not imply applicability or successful execution.

requirement_cases.situation: An approach specification is readable; an execution action lacks required permission.
requirement_cases.consequence: Specification access does not supply execution authorization.

requirement_cases.situation: A precise claim happens to be true although the assessor has no supporting information.
requirement_cases.consequence: Truth and warranted acceptance have different requirements.

requirement_cases.situation: A measurement returns stable scores unrelated to the target property.
requirement_cases.consequence: Repeatability does not establish proxy validity.

requirement_cases.situation: A SAT selector chooses an executable solver; a motor task selects a physical response.
requirement_cases.consequence: Shared selection structure permits analogy but not subject or mechanism identity.

requirement_cases.situation: A model computes attention weights; a person sustains attention during a task.
requirement_cases.consequence: Lexical identity does not establish computational or neural equivalence.

requirement_cases.situation: A graph permits ever cheaper walks through a reachable negative cycle.
requirement_cases.consequence: A route can exist without an attained minimum under that walk definition.

requirement_cases.situation: A correctly authorized rule produces none of its intended benefits in a measured case.
requirement_cases.consequence: Authority, compliance and causal effectiveness are separate matters.

requirement_cases.situation: A specified scalp feature is claimed to predict a specified trait in a declared population.
requirement_cases.consequence: The relation is a real investigable subject even if the predictive claim fails.

requirement_cases.situation: Additional retained records increase retrieval effort enough to reduce later usable benefit.
requirement_cases.consequence: Retention quantity is not the objective; cost and future use need comparison.

requirement_cases.situation: A new subject label describes part of an existing solver-selection literature.
requirement_cases.consequence: Missing from this catalog does not establish neglect in the world.

requirement_cases.situation: Plot is mapped only to presentation order.
requirement_cases.consequence: The translation leaves causal organization and other intended readings uncovered; record the residual.

requirement_cases.situation: An exploration uses extra resources but supplies information required by the stated task.
requirement_cases.consequence: It is not proved wasteful by comparing it only to a cheaper familiar answer.

requirement_cases.situation: Two exclusive-use options trade payoffs; scheduling improves both relative to chaotic sharing.
requirement_cases.consequence: The broad outcome domain is not constant-sum, although a restricted subset can be.

requirement_cases.situation: Scheduling is better for both participants than chaotic sharing, but worse for one participant than exclusive use.
requirement_cases.consequence: Both-benefit relative to one baseline is not best-for-everyone over the whole feasible set.

requirement_cases.situation: Feasible performance values approach 1 but every feasible value is less than 1.
requirement_cases.consequence: A supremum is not an attained perfect result.

requirement_cases.situation: The same consequence becomes acceptable only after the standard changes.
requirement_cases.consequence: That can be a defensible goal revision; it is not evidence of improved judgment under the original standard.

requirement_cases.situation: A low-probability contingency receives preparation because its unprepared cost is high.
requirement_cases.consequence: Preparation does not imply the event was judged most likely.

requirement_cases.situation: An assistant anticipates that it will write a table and then writes it.
requirement_cases.consequence: Agreement records plan realization; independent predictive accuracy remains untested.

requirement_cases.situation: A general rotation operation and its implementation mechanism are given separate names.
requirement_cases.consequence: Removing mental need not discard the original human-internal case or merge the two targets.

requirement_cases.situation: A paper gives a mathematical use of belief while leaving phenomenological relations open.
requirement_cases.consequence: Objection to the ordinary connotation alone does not refute the defined mathematical claim.

claim_review.label: Circular validation
claim_review.case: A method's only success test is that the same method endorses its output.
claim_review.status: Justification failure in the stated argument
claim_review.action: Specify independent or otherwise non-circular warrant for the claimed result.
claim_review.limit: This constructed case does not condemn self-reference in all forms.

claim_review.label: Reliable but invalid proxy
claim_review.case: A perfectly repeatable score is treated as evidence of an unrelated target property.
claim_review.action: Retain measurement of the score; separately test the intended inference.
claim_review.limit: Repeatability and validity are separate subjects.

claim_review.label: Universal claim with counterexample
claim_review.case: A stated universal permits a verified case that violates its conclusion.
claim_review.action: Preserve the counterexample and revise or withdraw that universal claim.
claim_review.limit: The underlying subject remains real and can become better developed.

claim_review.label: Unfalsifiable empirical rescue
claim_review.case: Every possible adverse observation is redefined as confirmation without a specified independent test.
claim_review.action: State what would count against the empirical claim and why.
claim_review.limit: Formal or normative questions need not use the same empirical test standard.

claim_review.label: Measured ineffective method
claim_review.case: Under fixed task conditions, a method repeatedly fails its specified completion criterion.
claim_review.action: Record the task, failures and comparison; change or retire that method for this scope.
claim_review.limit: Do not infer failure on every untested task.

claim_review.label: Elaborate unsupported theory
claim_review.case: A large body of detailed claims supplies no adequate support for its central dependency.
claim_review.action: Record elaboration separately from evidence; identify the exact dependency to test.
claim_review.limit: Complexity, longevity and confidence are not support by themselves.

claim_review.label: Scalp shape predicts personality
claim_review.case: A specified scalp feature is proposed to predict a specified trait in a declared population.
claim_review.status: Empirical target; results review pending here
claim_review.action: A 2018 primary study supplies a concrete test; inspect full results before assigning a verdict.
claim_review.limit: The abstract's description of a test is not enough to infer its outcome.

claim_review.label: Normative disagreement
claim_review.case: Two explicit ethical frameworks yield different recommendations.
claim_review.action: Identify conflicting standards and examine their justification.
claim_review.limit: Empirical popularity alone does not settle the conflict.

claim_review.label: Counterfactual object
claim_review.case: A question asks what follows in a precisely specified hypothetical world.
claim_review.action: Investigate consistency and consequences under the stated assumptions.
claim_review.limit: Actual existence is not required for a hypothetical subject to be precise.

claim_review.label: Narrow but useful traditional name
claim_review.case: A standard technical term already has a stable, discriminating definition.
claim_review.status: Retain or alias after scope comparison
claim_review.action: Keep its connection to the literature; a more literal label need not replace a precise established one.
claim_review.limit: Familiar technical names are not placeholders merely because they are concise.

claim_review.limit: This does not establish the empirical universality of the theory.

admission_rules.test: State what is considered, what possible findings differ, and which case parameters change its meaning.
Give a case in which the nearby matter is settled while this one remains open, or justify an explicit qualification relation.
Do not enumerate operations that the actual target does not support.
Use the general subject, the target and its determination; no conjunction joining independent subjects.
Compare definitions, aliases and qualifications before admitting another canonical entry. Prefixes do not prove scope relations.
A partial source translation must record what it leaves unanswered; exact equivalence requires a stronger argument.
A well-defined subject can have unknown answers, failed techniques or false claims; none is permission to fabricate findings.
Catalog admission does not commit equal implementation effort. Develop subjects whose next result matters to a stated purpose.
Coverage is relative to a declared corpus or domain. New cases may demand new subjects or revised boundaries.
